strategy.success_criterion: On buggy 958cc95aebc3 with flint ground types, test_cancel_modulus fails: the first assert cancel((x**2 - 1)/(x + 1), modulus=2) == x + 1 or the Poly(...).cancel(...) assert raises AssertionError from 'assert f.dom == g.dom in (ZZ, QQ)' in DUP_Flint._cancel.
